crossRefs.note: A reed like a rod was given to me. Someone said, “Rise, and measure God’s temple, and the altar, and those who worship…
Leave out the court which is outside of the temple, and don’t measure it, for it has been given to the nations. They…
You shall put the ark of the covenant in it, and you shall screen the ark with the veil.
He brought me to the temple, and measured the posts, six cubits wide on the one side, and six cubits wide on the other…
I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.

translations.web: He who spoke with me had for a measure a golden reed to measure the city, its gates, and its walls.
translations.bsb: The angel who spoke with me had a golden measuring rod to measure the city and its gates and walls.
translations.kjv: And he that talked with me had a golden reed to measure the city, and the gates thereof, and the wall thereof.
translations.asv: And he that spake with me had for a measure a golden reed to measure the city, and the gates thereof, and the wall thereof.
